body: Unrelated to the PR, what's the point of swapping these around?
What's the purpose of storing all colors, instead of just one?

Preferred, `append` is a compatibility method, for all these

Since RTL_BOLD_ITALICS_FONT can be set after either RTL_BOLD_FONT or RTL_ITALICS_FONT is set (because pushing either tag on the other automatically sets bold_italics), I wanted to ensure that bold or italics would not return before bold_italics. I'm not sure if this actually wound up helping to fix the issues, but It seems like a good idea in any case.

Edit: I had found a more robust way of fixing the issue, so my original motive for switching this around might no longer apply.
I might not be understanding the question correctly, but the outline color and font color can be different. They can also be different for each list line. Please elaborate if I've misunderstood.
`prefix_outline_color_info` is a `Array`, but only the one value at index `0` is used, so it can be a single `Color` instead.
Only one enum case can be triggered at a time, and it's an exact match, so order does not change anything here.

I'm using the non-empty `Array` to test if a color has been assigned, rather than comparing to some default `Color`, because `Color` can't be `nullptr`. Can you advise on a better way to do this? Color could be transparent?
I'll revert this back to original.
